action: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Marcus, who sits at a desk in The Talk Show Studio. Across the desk, Omar and Leo sit with somber expressions. Omar nods slowly as he listens, while Leo shifts his weight slightly, both listening intently. the vintage Texaco sign hangs on the brick wall in the background.

At night in Stillwater Fairgrounds, spectators wearing the assorted cowboy hats fill the arena stands, below the rodeo banner. Cassidy and Riley walk together along a crowded row of seats, searching for a place to sit.
Close-up of Nina sitting in the dimly lit The Oakwood Study. She holds the ornate storybook open on her lap as she speaks.
So-hee, wearing the 'WHENEVER' sweatshirt, listens intently, her facial expression changing from concern to surprise as her eyes widen.

At Disaster Zone Alpha, Nina, and Sara stand behind the folding plastic table, serving food and drinks. Alex hands a plate of food across the table to Cassidy, wearing the black cowboy hat. In the hazy background, the disaster response truck is parked amidst the rubble.

In the busy interior of The Commons Eatery, Nora and Chloe sit at the small cafe table with Leo. Nora reads the deep red menu while Leo eats his food. Leo, wearing the yellow jacket, gets up from the table and walks toward the food counter in the background as Nora looks up to watch him go.

objects: the white shirt and black vest

action: In the foreground, the vintage gas mask rests on a dusty surface inside the cluttered The Dusty Attic at night. In the background, Julian, wearing the white shirt and black vest, cautiously walks through the space, holding the lit red pillar candle which illuminates the room.
View from behind Simon as he walks down the narrow, dark Cobblestone Alley at night. He emerges onto a bustling city street, filled with car traffic and pedestrians on the sidewalks.

A medium eye-level side view pans left to follow the dark SUV as it drives down Cityside Street during the day. Inside, Arthur is driving and looking straight ahead, while Leo, in the passenger seat, gestures animatedly. In the background, the electric rental scooters are parked on the side of the road.
From over Vikram's shoulder, Leena, wearing the crone disguise, stares intently at him. She leans forward slightly, her gaze fixed.

Over-the-shoulder shot in All Saints Doctor's Office, focusing on Gabriela. She sits at the cluttered side desk and looks up with an expression of wide-eyed shock. In the foreground, Marcus raises his hand in a stopping gesture, while Evan stands beside him, looking on with concern. In the background, medical textbooks, including the stack of medical textbooks, fill the packed medical bookshelf.

In The Medical Center Lobby, Min-jun and Dr. Park sit across from each other at the small wooden table. Dr. Park speaks with a serious expression, while Min-jun listens intently with a look of concern. Ji-woo stands nearby, watching them, as the paper water cup rests on the table.

Walter, Nico, and Julian stand beside the light blue bathtub, which is filled with the floral bathwater and the floating flowers. They lean over to look down into the water, their expressions shifting to concern.

In The Hospital Room, Min-jun sits dejectedly on the bright green bench, staring down at the floor. Ji-hoon, wearing a dark suit, stands nearby, watching him. Suddenly, Min-jun snaps his head up, alerted by a sound.

Daytime medium shot in The Garden Steps, with the ornate lamppost visible. Marco and Maya stand on a curved stone staircase, having a serious conversation. Marco gestures as he talks, while Maya listens intently with her hands in her pockets. A tall, ornate lamppost stands near them.

Over-the-shoulder shot in The Tribunal Chamber. Claire, wearing the green dress uniform, and Evelyn sit side-by-side at the long hearing table, listening with serious expressions. Claire picks up the black and gold pen from the table.
In the dimly lit The Bedroom, Leo, wearing the charcoal gray t-shirt, is startled and sharply turns his head to the side as if reacting to something off-screen.

A scared figure wearing the smiley face hoodie peeks from behind a wall at Fiona and Anya in the dimly lit hallway. They then hurry down the hall and enter an open doorway into The Cluttered Workshop.

Medium shot of a backyard party at night in The Tiki Patio, illuminated by the globe string lights and the bamboo tiki torches. Ryan looks down into the red party cup he is holding, a pensive expression on his face. Beside him, Dolores dances happily. In the background, Marco, Dante, Ben, and Sam mingle and talk amongst themselves.

Medium shot in Strawberry Field Farm. Arthur crouches, picking the fresh strawberries from the plants. Maya stands nearby, holding the woven picking basket. In the background, Amara also works in the field. Suddenly, Arthur and Maya stop what they are doing and look off-screen to the right with concerned expressions.

Inside The Command Center at night, Nico leans over the holographic console, speaking seriously to Julian, who stands with his back to the camera and nods slightly. Caleb stands behind them, his arms crossed as he listens to the conversation with a concerned expression. Alex stands nearby, their eyes scanning the data on a large screen.

In Gritstone Quarry, Crag gestures, causing a single cinder block to magically levitate and place itself on the cinder block wall. Nearby, Korg watches in confusion, holding the claymation trowel. The blue alien uniform lies on the ground.

Marco walks through The Jungle Outpost with a concerned expression. Ryker, wearing the green tactical vest, walks beside him as an escort, while Kai follows closely. In the background, another soldier stands guard near a wooden structure.

Close-up profile shot of Caleb leaning in towards the vintage studio microphone in the dimly lit The Crimson Studio. An intense red glow illuminates his pensive face as he takes a slow breath. In the deeply blurred background, Silas stands and watches him.

Inside The Starlight Diner, Frank, wearing the waiter's uniform and the white waist apron, walks behind the long service counter. Nia stands on the customer side of the counter, turning slightly to watch him.
